title: Do Safety Guardrails Need to Reason? LeanGuard: A Fast and Light Approach for Robust Moderation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical architecture and efficiency of LLM safety guardrails. While it evaluates models on 'harm' detection tasks using standard safety datasets, it investigates the mechanism of classification (Chain-of-Thought vs. single-pass encoders) rather than analyzing ethical frameworks, moral philosophies, or religious values.
